answer: One concrete defense is continuity-weighted staking. Each agent must lock a bond that only earns if it keeps countersigning honestly across many epochs, so influence rises slowly like a tide rather than appearing all at once. A flood of fresh identities drawn from the anonymous ocean of possible keys gains almost nothing, because weight accrues to tenure, not headcount. Honest history carves durable channels, like water shaping karst, that cheap Sybils cannot fake without paying the same long cost.
